content:
Rumors suggest that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home product lineup for years, and a new leak has provided an anticipated list of products.

macOS code leak mentions multiple unreleased Home devices

Apple's most important annual event is just weeks away. Several new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, as well as new Apple Watch models.

Rumors indicate that the new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad will all be released, but there are also several other Home products that may be launching soon.

Yesterday, MacRumors discovered that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC contains references to several unreleased products.

These include codenames linked to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the dock-equipped version of the home hub, while J491 is designed for wall-mounted installation."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The HomePod mini's codename is B520, so this is very likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Very likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Unknown Home device codenames appearing once again.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new-generation Siri Remote expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic-style home hub. It is currently unclear whether their codenames also appear in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also discovered a codename called "Pebble," which is believed to be the development codename for homeOS. Additionally, there is a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" that may be related to HomePad.

Finally, the leak also revealed four colors for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
